title: College Football
description:
Ball State at Northwestern
Ball State visits Northwestern in a game in Week 6. Ball State lost 39-24 to Toledo in Week 5 for its third loss, while home team Northwestern beat Penn State 34-13. Keldric Luster leads Ball State, while Aidan Chiles leads Northwestern.

title: B1G  Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: College Football
description:
Maryland at Ohio State
Maryland (2-3) visits No. 5 Ohio State (4-1). Maryland seeks to snap a three-game skid and lost 48-23 to Nebraska despite Malik Washington's TD and two INTs. Ohio State beat Iowa 31-14 behind three Julian Sayin TDs, bringing his season total to 13.

title: B1G  Football Game Break

title: College Football
description:
Minnesota at Purdue
The Minnesota Golden Gophers visit the Purdue Boilermakers in a Big Ten game in Week 6. Minnesota beat Michigan 20-14 in Week 5 for its third straight win. Drake Lindsey leads Minnesota, while Purdue quarterback Ryan Browne leads the Boilermakers.
